subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the parenthesis. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: Everybody knows that (a) smoke is a (b) danger bad habit. It is (c) harm to health. It is also (d) cost. A (e) smoke should not smoke (f) public. Smoking creates (g) pollute. A single puff of cigarette contains (h) numerable harmful particles that cause many (i) respirator diseases which are incurable. But there are many people who are (j) aware of the bad effects of smoking.
guide_solution: (a) smoking (b) dangerous (c) harmful (d) costly (e) smoker (f) publicly (g) pollution (h) innumerable (i) respiratory (j) unaware
